Here are some museums in the Netherlands related to the Holocaust that I found using the EHRI-KG MCP server:

1. **[NIOD Instituut voor Oorlogs-, Holocaust- en Genocidestudies](https://portal.ehri-project.eu/institutions/nl-002896)**
   - Focuses on research and documentation of wars, the Holocaust, and genocides.

2. **[Anne Frank Stichting](https://portal.ehri-project.eu/institutions/nl-002892)**
   - Dedicated to the preservation of Anne Frank's legacy and the history of the Holocaust.

3. **[Verzetsmuseum (Dutch Resistance Museum)](https://portal.ehri-project.eu/institutions/nl-002893)**
   - Focuses on the Dutch resistance during World War II, including aspects related to the Holocaust.

4. **[Joods Museum (Jewish Museum)](https://portal.ehri-project.eu/institutions/nl-002895)**
   - Covers Jewish history, culture, and the Holocaust in the Netherlands.

5. **[Herinneringscentrum Kamp Westerbork](https://portal.ehri-project.eu/institutions/nl-005846)**
   - A memorial center located at the site of the former Westerbork transit camp, where many Dutch Jews were held before being deported to concentration camps.

6. **[Verzetsmuseum, Friesland](https://portal.ehri-project.eu/institutions/nl-002927)**
   - Focuses on the resistance movement in Friesland during World War II, including Holocaust-related history.

7. **[Oorlogs en Verzetsmuseum (War and Resistance Museum)](https://portal.ehri-project.eu/institutions/nl-002978)**
   - Covers the history of World War II and the resistance in the Netherlands, including Holocaust-related topics.

8. **[Etty Hillesum Centrum](https://portal.ehri-project.eu/institutions/nl-002918)**
   - Dedicated to the life and work of Etty Hillesum, a Jewish woman who documented her experiences during the Holocaust in the Netherlands.

9. **[Stichting Sjoa - Sjoa Foundation](https://portal.ehri-project.eu/institutions/nl-004866)**
   - Focuses on the history of the Holocaust and its impact on Dutch society.

10. **[Maror](https://portal.ehri-project.eu/institutions/nl-004867)**
    - A foundation that works on preserving the memory of the Holocaust and educating about its history.

You can explore these institutions further using their respective EHRI Portal links.
